plan: In a single-round auction with values drawn from $0-$20, a dominant strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. With a value of $13, I want to win if possible, but minimize my payment. Other rational bidders will likely bid similarly. I'll aim to bid around $11-$12 - high enough to likely win, but low enough to potentially create a profitable margin if my bid is the second highest.

In a second-price sealed bid auction with values drawn from $0-$20, the optimal strategy is typically to bid close to, but not exceeding, my true value. Since my value is $11, I'll bid strategically. Other rational bidders will likely bid near their own values. I'll bid $10.90 - just under my true value - to maximize potential profit while protecting against overpaying. This leaves room for potential earnings if my value is higher than competing bids.
